mentions.name: Amber.jl
mentions.description: An acausal analog electronics simulation tool driven by Julia code, in which the circuit is expressed as code the same way a neural network is code in PyTorch. Version 0.1.0 is nearly ready and a public GitHub repository is planned.
mentions.problem: SPICE wasn't built for programmers in mind.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on Amber.jl an acausal analog electronics simulation tool driven by Julia code. Just like in PyTorch, the neural network is the code, here the circuit is the code as well.
